We'll write test methods using JUnit 4 @Test, assertEquals, assertTrue, assertFalse, assertNull, etc.

Need to create Attribute objects; there is class Attribute in jsoup. We'll assume constructors: new Attribute(String key, String value). Also BooleanAttribute maybe used.

Test details:

- testPutAndGet: put key "Foo" value "Bar", get returns "Bar". getIgnoreCase with different case works.

- testPutOverwrite: put same key again changes value.

- testPutBooleanTrue: put("checked", true) should add attribute with null value; getIgnoreCase returns "" (empty) because checkNotNull returns empty string for null. Also hasKeyIgnoreCase true.

- testPutBooleanFalse: after adding attribute, put("checked", false) removes it.

- testRemove: after adding, remove key works case-sensitive; removeIgnoreCase works case-insensitive.

- testSizeAndHasKey: size increments.

- testAddAll: create another Attributes with some keys, addAll and ensure merging and overwrite behavior.

- testIteratorAndRemoveViaIterator: use iterator to remove an element via iterator.remove, verify size decreased.

- testAsList: ensure list size equals attributes size, elements have correct keys/values, immutable (throws UnsupportedOperationException on add).

- testDataset: put data attributes via attributes.put("data-name","value"); dataset().get("name") returns value; dataset().put("age","30") adds data-age; iteration size correct; remove via dataset iterator.

- testHtml: create attributes with normal and boolean attribute; verify html string formatting (e.g., key="value" and boolean attribute appears as "checked" without =). But implementation: boolean attribute is stored as null; html method: if val null, it will skip attribute value if syntax html and conditions. It will output " checked". Actually code: accum.append(' ').append(key); then if not (out.syntax == html && (val == null || val.equals(key) && Attribute.isBooleanAttribute(key))) then output ="value". For val null -> condition true, so skip value. So html should be " key". We'll test.

- testEqualsAndHashCode: clone equality, modifications break equality.

- testClone: clone creates deep copy; modifications to original not affect clone.

- testNormalize: keys case changed to lower.

Edge cases: indexOfKey null => Validate.notNull throws IllegalArgumentException? Validate.notNull likely throws IllegalArgumentException. We can test that calling get(null) throws NullPointerException? Actually get calls indexOfKey, which Validate.notNull(key) will throw IllegalArgumentException. We'll test expecting IllegalArgumentException.

But we need to import Validate? Not needed.

Write test class AttributesTest.
